dsDescriptionValue.value: The Person Agreement Database (PAD) contains analytical (language-level) data for over 400 languages of the world on person agreement and some related areas such as word order. The information is coded in terms of over 250 variables. For a subset of these, citations to relevant pages in reference grammars are given.
